### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/client`, touching **14** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/client/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/client/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **28** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e9a55fd79ef96a02cedc65abec4b1565cc838170` — the merge of head `7ec2fb6c717c2095b2645eb234d1d3e0d8ef3845` into base `cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e9a55fd79ef96a02cedc65abec4b1565cc838170 && git checkout e9a55fd79ef96a02cedc65abec4b1565cc838170
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939 7ec2fb6c717c2095b2645eb234d1d3e0d8ef3845 && git checkout -B drift-repro cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939 && git merge --no-ff 7ec2fb6c717c2095b2645eb234d1d3e0d8ef3845

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cb9841aa253227625738d0e7dbf9add7853fe939` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

### ① Derived judgments

Every public-surface change the diff implies:
- **`os meta delete --package ID`: right.** It forwards verbatim as `DeleteMetaItemOptions.packageId` (`?package=`) through `metaDeleteOptions`, and combines with `--draft` and `--if-match`.
- **`os meta register --package ID`: right.** It forwards verbatim as `SaveMetaItemOptions.packageId` through the new `metaRegisterOptions`. That function returns `undefined` when the flag is unset, so an unflagged register still sends the active save with no query string. That byte-for-byte equality is pinned on the wire.
- **An empty or blank `--package` is refused before a client exists, on both commands: right.** This matches the existing empty `--if-match` refusal. Both docblocks give the reason, and it holds against the measured door: a package-less request is resolved to one row, not refused, when one package holds the item. A degrade-to-package-less path would write or remove a row the operator did not name. This goes beyond triage's pins, and it narrows nothing that worked: an empty `--package` never existed.
- **The carrier docblocks: right.** `DeleteMetaItemOptions` and `metaDeleteOptions` now name the door's five carriers (`If-Match`, `state`, `package`, `dropStorage`, `member`) instead of counting them. They keep the `dropStorage` ruling (cf71d73f8), and they record `member` as an undeclared SDK member, not as a ruling.
- **No published package entry moves.** `metaRegisterOptions` and the two refusal constants are exported from command modules, the convention `metaDeleteOptions` already follows, not from a package `exports` entry. `@objectstack/client` changes docblock text only.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset bumps `@objectstack/cli` to `minor`, which is right for a widening: two new optional flags.
- It bumps `@objectstack/client` to `patch`, which is right for docblock text with no type or behaviour change.
- It carries `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, the same as the claim and as PR body line 2.
- No ADR-0087 disposition is owed: nothing narrows or retires.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Open questions:** the dev report has none.
- **H2, measured:** `register` saves active. A package-less active save of an item two packages hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with nothing written, which is the case the flag answers.
- **H4, measured:** no generated CLI reference reads these flags. Nothing was regenerated.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - **Two class-(a) findings, measured at a public door, are filed by the seat as their own cards:**
    - the human output of `os meta delete` says "Metadata deleted" when the door answered `reset: false`;
    - `os meta register` cannot send the `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` 409's `?force=true` remedy.
  - **Two notes stay Acceptance notes (承接者:无):**
    - `--package all` reaches the door as package-less. That is by design: verbatim forwarding.
    - A historical test header narrates "three carriers".
- **Check-runs on the head, at this read:** 16 success, 6 skipped, 15 in progress, 0 failures. The flip waits for an all-green head.
